description: Defines utility functions and checks for tensor shape validation, concatenation, splitting, and dimension consistency within the ATen/native namespace of PyTorch.

methods.name: clone_preserve_strides
methods.description: Creates a clone of the input tensor while preserving its strides.

methods.name: cat_should_skip_tensor
methods.description: Determines if a tensor should be skipped during concatenation based on its shape.

methods.name: check_cat_shape_except_dim
methods.description: Checks if two tensors have compatible shapes for concatenation along a specified dimension.

methods.name: check_cat_no_zero_dim
methods.description: Ensures tensors are not zero-dimensional before concatenation.

methods.name: get_num_splits
methods.description: Calculates the number of splits for a tensor given a split size and dimension.

methods.name: have_same_ndims
methods.description: Checks if all tensors in a list have the same number of dimensions.

methods.name: leading_dimension_matches
methods.description: Verifies that tensors have matching leading dimensions up to a specified dimension.

methods.name: preprocess_chunk_cat_inputs
methods.description: Validates and preprocesses tensors for chunking and concatenation operations.
